categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies JSON-RPC argument handling for `estimatesmartfee`.
categories.rationale: Resolves an interface inconsistency where `estimatesmartfee` rejected named arguments for its options, unlike other RPC methods. As noted in the description, this inconsistency was 'confusing and not user friendly' for callers relying on named parameters.
